div.div: لُؤَمَةٌ , (S, K,) or ↓ لُؤْمَةٌ , (M, IB,) The whole apparatus, or gear, of the plough: (AHn, S, M, K:) or its iron [or share] and its wooden parts: (M:) or the سِنَّة [or ploughshare] with which the earth is ploughed up, and which, when upon the plough, is termed عِيَانٌ, pl. عين: (IAar, TA:) the سِكَّة. (IB, TA.) See عِيَانٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
